commands: set -eu; echo '=== CANDIDATES ==='; find /Users/michal -maxdepth 7 -type d -name local-climate-link-starter -prune 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r repo; do if git -C "$repo" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "--- $repo ---"; printf 'ORIGIN='; git -C "$repo" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true; printf 'BRANCH='; git -C "$repo" branch --show-current || true; printf 'HEAD='; git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD || true; echo 'STATUS:'; git -C "$repo" status --short --branch || true; echo 'DIFF_STAT:'; git -C "$repo" diff --stat || true; echo 'STAGED_STAT:'; git -C "$repo" diff --cached --stat || true; echo 'CHANGED_COUNT:'; git -C "$repo" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' '; fi; done
